featured_reviews.name: Paramhans Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Biryani Ever – Avoid at All Costs
Don't fall for good review
I ordered biryani from on December 31st for my daughter's birthday party, and it was an absolute disaster. The biryani was horrific—the rice was uncooked, the taste was revolting, and it was obvious that the food was prepared by amateurs with zero culinary skills.

The food quality was so bad that none of my guests could eat it. To make matters worse, they promised to refund my money after I complained, but even after 4 days, I have received nothing. Adding to the frustration, they haven’t even bothered to collect their pot back.

This place is the epitome of unprofessionalism and irresponsibility. They ruined my event and caused unnecessary stress. Avoid them at all costs if you care about your sanity and reputation!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Mr. Yadav,

We always appreciate feedback but prefer it to be fair and constructive. Let’s set the record straight with complete transparency:

We have reviewed your profile and seen your feedback about Barbeque Nation, where it seems the food didn't meet your expectations, along with a few other outlets. Given that, we may not place much weight on your average review. We, on the other hand, personally visit these places, and while we are in the same business, we genuinely appreciate their food. If your experiences don’t align, perhaps you should consider dining at Michelin-starred establishments.

1. The Root Cause: The issue with the rice occurred because it was freshly harvested from a new batch we specifically opened for your order. While fresh rice can sometimes result in slight texture variations, we tested the same batch with other team members, and they did not find it as disappointing as you have described.

2. Sample Approved: You picked up the sample beforehand, tasted it, and gave your approval. This makes your sudden dissatisfaction puzzling, especially since the same preparation process was followed for the final order.

3. Respectful Refund: The moment you provided feedback, we didn’t hesitate to offer a refund, despite the fact that your tone escalated with threats of a negative review. We respect every customer, even under such circumstances.

4. Price vs. Expectations: For ₹600/kg  Paneer Biryani (a price you negotiated from ₹600/kg and tried reducing to ₹550/kg), you seemed to expect gourmet-level biryani worthy of a five-star chef. To put this in perspective, high-end chefs charge significantly more, especially for large orders.

5. Pot: Asking us to collect the pot with leftovers still inside is unprofessional. Returning it clean, as is standard practice, would have been a simple gesture of mutual respect. Since we provide takeaways and delivery as a token of respect, and you came to collect a sample, I hope you understand. I agree where we are lagging, but be an effective communicator and then expect the same in return.

PS: You don’t need to disrespect the food, and as we mentioned during the call, you can recycle the pot. We will initiate your return as you have paid half payment ₹1500, but only once the pot is returned cleaned, since we didn’t promise delivery. If we are making this adjustment as a token of respect, we expect to be treated the same way.

We take pride in treating all customers professionally and upholding quality in our work. However, exaggerations and one-sided stories do not align with the mutual respect that makes association meaningful.

Absolutely terrible drive-through experience. We waited at the drive-through ordering point for a long time and even honked multiple times, but nobody came to take our order. After a lengthy wait, a staff member finally approached us only to tell us to come inside the restaurant to place the order and make the payment.

This completely defeats the purpose of having a drive-through. If customers are expected to park, walk inside, place the order, and pay at the counter, then why advertise a drive-through service at all?

The entire experience was frustrating, unprofessional, and a complete waste of time. A drive-through is meant to provide convenience and speed, but this outlet failed to deliver even the most basic level of service. Management seriously needs to improve staff responsiveness and ensure the drive-through operates as intended.

Time :- 19-June-2026 10.30 Am
